🀄 MANDARIN QUIZ
01 · Core features

Small interactions. Meaningful practice.

The prototype focuses on clear feedback, learner control, and a consistent interface across screen sizes.

🎚️

Session length

Choose 5, 10, 15, 20, or 30 questions for a short or extended practice session.

🗣️

Mandarin speech

Use browser speech synthesis to hear Mandarin phrases where a suitable voice is available.

🔔

Sound effects

Optional short audio cues provide feedback for correct and incorrect answers.

🎭

Character reactions

Clear visual feedback and response states make each choice easy to understand.

📈

Live progress

Score, question count, accuracy, and a progress bar update during each case.

📱

Responsive design

A dark-blue visual system adapts the learning experience to desktop and mobile screens.

02 · User journey

One round. Five simple steps.

A simple loop: meet, choose, check, learn, and continue. The feedback appears after the learner chooses, so the game teaches instead of revealing the answer first.

01

MEET

A character presents a clue in Chinese.

02

CHOOSE

Pick the matching phrase or meaning.

03

CHECK

The game marks the answer and updates points.

04

LEARN

Review Pinyin, English meaning, and explanation.

05

CONTINUE

Complete the selected number of questions.

03 · Interactive prototype

Practice Mandarin. Discover new phrases.

Choose a session length and answer each question. Your score and progress update as you play. Use the speaker button to hear the phrase when your browser supports Mandarin speech.

04 · Learning design

Characters. Pinyin. Meaning.

A beginner-friendly phrase bank connects written Chinese, pronunciation, and English meaning. Use the speaker buttons to hear individual examples.

Learning loop

Learn by retrieving and reviewing

  • Retrieve a phrase from a clue.
  • Get immediate feedback.
  • Review the correct answer and Pinyin.
  • Practise again with a new question.
05 · The idea

Why learn Mandarin through a game?

Language practice can feel repetitive when it relies only on memorising word lists. Mandarin Mystery turns beginner vocabulary into short missions where learners make a choice, receive feedback, and try again.

🧩

The challenge

New learners need to connect Chinese characters, pronunciation (Pinyin), and meaning at the same time.

⚡

The opportunity

Short interactive tasks invite learners to actively choose, check, and correct their answers.

🕵️

Our approach

Turn vocabulary practice into a mystery: follow clues, question witnesses, and solve a case.

Project goal: make beginner Mandarin practice more engaging, understandable, and easy to repeat.
